status_definition.passed: Original procedure met on the explicitly stated local component scope; this is not live Zoom acceptance.
status_definition.partial: Executed evidence covers only part or an adaptation of the original procedure.
status_definition.not_applicable: Feature absent; not counted as passed.

scope: Synthetic data, local isolated processes and queues, actual local Whisper/Codex, GitHub-hosted installation runners. No real Zoom, Claude or DeepSeek acceptance.

scenarios.remaining: Bounded request experiment is not indefinite DoS/load certification.

scenarios.title: Чистая установка на целевых ОС

scenarios.remaining: Windows 11, real Zoom on all OS and independent novice not tested. Windows MCP unsupported; 32 component tests skipped there.

scenarios.title: Повтор установки и смена SDK
scenarios.observed: Actual published SDK 6.5.0 -> 6.10.0 -> 6.5.0 installation, script/archive hashes and preserved backups pass. CI inventories/model hashes published. Additional real browser check exposed missing ReactRedux and UI assets. Fixed installer repeats 6.5 -> 6.10 -> 6.5 and all three bundle bootstraps load without page errors or HTTP asset failures.
scenarios.remaining: Actual SDK meeting smoke after each version change; exact all-platform dependency lock not claimed. Zoom documents Web Meeting SDK for human use, not AI bots; RTMS is not implemented here.

scenarios.title: Самостоятельный запуск новичком
scenarios.observed: Agent setup/skill checks and automated fresh installations pass.
scenarios.remaining: An independent novice must complete a local first run without author assistance; automation is not a substitute.
